visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Raw Type Loses the Element Type
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The program does not compile: the Box was declared without a type argument, so get() returns a plain Object.

solution.explanation: Using the generic class without a type argument (a raw type) makes get() return Object, and Object has no toUpperCase method. Writing Box<String> tells the compiler the value is a String.
